notes.title: Escape from Stellar Island Announcement
notes.content:
Been a long while since I have last come out with an update. Originally, I had a lot planned for The Broston Saga, but eventually came to the realization that it was worth putting my effort more into working on a sequel rather than continue updates for this. So with that in mind...

Introducing...

[u][h1][b]Escape from Stellar Island[/b][/h1][/u]

Taking place a little while after The Broston Saga, experience a brand new story with a whole new set of characters across an exciting new adventure! Witness the aftermath of Blackwatch with a mysterious new force ready to strike you down around every corner. Explore the terrain of Stellar Island alongside its many secrets and uncover the truth behind the history of Blackwatch.

More details coming soon. As of now, I have released one final patch fixing a few bugs.

[u][b]D.J's Redemption[/b][/u]

[b]Fixed:[/b]

-Doll Maker quest triggers
-Chapter 4 dialogue triggers
-Decreased the amount of grind required during Chapter 4

notes.title: The Broston Saga is out now!
notes.content:
The Broston Saga is likely going to be one of the greatest JRPGs you have ever played! Take the role of Tyrone Broston and venture out on your quest to take back the hood from your rivals, "The Cripos." With your companions by your side, what can possibly go wrong? The Broston Saga features three different stories:


[h2]The Legend of Tyrone[/h2]

[list]
[*] Command a Squad of 8-bit Gangsters
[/list]
With a variety of different weapons, equip your best men with Shotguns, AK-47's, Bondage Masks, etc.

[list]
[*] Dive into a Deep and Story Rich Environment
[/list]
Mysteries are all around! Chat and become the modern hero you have always wished to become!

[list]
[*] Enemy Variety
[/list]
Fight through hordes of unpredictable enemies that will leave you on the edge of your seat.

[list]
[*] Unique Characters
[/list]
Each and every character holds a story worth learning.

[b](Not responsible for loss of braincells)[/b]


[h2]The Adventures of Tyrone[/h2]

[list]
[*] Command and Equip Your Squad
[/list]
New and familiar faces alike. Command up to five different characters all with unique abilities.

[list]
[*] Decisions Matter
[/list]
They don't

[list]
[*] Learn the Secrets of Inner City
[/list]
Explore and meet new faces in this epic super cool adventure!

[list]
[*] Gear up your boys
[/list]
A game so grindy, it'll make you want to use a save editor!

[list]
[*] Over 5-10 Hours of Gameplay
[/list]
Yeah it's pretty long. Hope you got popcorn.

[h2]D'Js Redemption[/h2]

[list]
[*] Finish off with a bang!
[/list]
Conclude the saga by ending things off with a bang! Learn the truth behind everything and finally put the story to rest.

[list]
[*] New Raids!
[/list]
Unlike in the previous chapters, partake in brand new Raids that will put your skills to the ultimate test.

[list]
[*] New Map / Environment
[/list]
The desert plains echo your name. Are YOU brave enough to explore these lands?
